A channel is seeded as verified+enabled only when seed_channels.mjs re-proves the evidence below live: the public Atom feed title equals feed_title AND (verified_badge on the channel page OR the channel is listed in the featured-channels grid of the verified UFC channel page). Anything that fails stays verified=false, enabled=false. See docs/videos.md.
